name: rust-engineering
description: Automatic Rust engineering orchestration with 43 focused coding, review, verification, language, Cargo, architecture, runtime, interop, and Nix skills.

interface.shortDescription: Route Rust work through focused skills.
interface.longDescription: Starts with a fast read-only Rust context hook, then routes implementation through one primary and at most two supporting engineering profiles. Includes findings-first review, evidence-only verification, Rust language and Cargo policy, architecture, runtime, interop, and Nix workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $rust-workflow to inspect this Rust project, select one primary and at most two supporting profiles, make the smallest coherent change, and verify the changed contract.
